import json, os, pathlib, runpy, sys
import cadgen, cadgen.viewer

dist, proof_path = sys.argv[1:]
proof = dict(pid=os.getpid(), python=sys.executable, cadgen=cadgen.__file__,
             viewer=cadgen.viewer.__file__, cwd=os.getcwd(), cache=os.environ.get('CADGEN_CACHE_DIR'),
             dist=dist, kernelLoadedBeforeLaunch=any(k.startswith(('OCP', 'build123d')) for k in sys.modules))
pathlib.Path(proof_path).write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2)+'\n')
sys.argv=['cadgen.viewer', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--ephemeral', '--no-registry', '--json', '--dist', dist]
runpy.run_module('cadgen.viewer', run_name='__main__')
